# ZaraSourcing — Hackathon Submission

**Problem:** Recruiters can't tell if resume claims are real. ATS tools score keywords; manual GitHub review takes 15+ min per candidate.

**Solution:** Agent that reads GitHub code, cites file:line evidence, runs AI voice interviews with AR proctoring, and ranks candidates — wrapped in a deployable SaaS. **The agent recommends; the qualified recruiter makes the final hire decision.**

**Benchmark (reproducible):** All accuracy numbers come from `backend/data/benchmark_results.json`, generated by `make evaluate`. The `/benchmark` page reads that same file — judges who re-run evaluate should see matching results.

**Live demo:** https://micro1-production.up.railway.app/demo  
**Company login:** https://micro1-production.up.railway.app/company/login (demo: `demo@zarasourcing.com` / `demo123`)  
**Public fraud report:** https://micro1-production.up.railway.app/report/riveradevops  
**Benchmark:** https://micro1-production.up.railway.app/benchmark  
**Backend API:** https://zarasourcing-production.up.railway.app  
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Junnygram/micro1

## Verified benchmark numbers

| Metric | Baseline | Agent |
|---|---|---|
| Verdict accuracy (10 cases) | **60%** (6/10) | **70%** (7/10) |
| Fraud / discrepancy detection (5 cases) | 1/5 | **5/5** |

Source: `backend/data/benchmark_results.json` — regenerate with `make evaluate` (see [REPRODUCTION.md](./REPRODUCTION.md)). Deployed `/benchmark` serves this file; it does not use inflated DB seed metrics.

Re-run after rotating API key: `make evaluate`

## 60-second pitch (read this in Loom intro)

> "Resume inflation breaks hiring. ATS gives 100/100 for copied tutorials. Our baseline — a single Gemini prompt with no tools — gets 60% accuracy on 10 cases. Our agent uses GitHub tools: list repos, list files, read code. It hits 70% verdict accuracy and catches all 5 discrepancy cases (exaggerated or failed claims) vs baseline's 1/5. We wrapped it in deployable SaaS — the recruiter makes the final decision. Reproduce with `make evaluate`."

## Before you submit

1. **Deploy to Railway** — backend + frontend (see [DEPLOY.md](./DEPLOY.md))
2. **Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`** to backend URL at frontend **build** time
3. **Mount SQLite volume** on backend `data/` so seeded candidates persist
4. **Record Loom on the deployed URL** — same link you paste in HackerEarth (not localhost)
5. **Smoke test `/demo`** — all 6 steps; steps 1–4 work without API keys
6. **Test audio** — Chrome, allow mic; Polly or browser TTS on interview
7. **Paste Railway URL** in submission: https://micro1-production.up.railway.app/demo
8. **Run [PRE_SUBMIT.md](./PRE_SUBMIT.md)** checklist on deploy
9. **Upload Loom link**
10. **Confirm trajectories** — 10 files in `backend/data/trajectories/`

### Judge reproducibility (what matches your video)

| Your Loom shows | Judge clicks | Needs API keys? |
|---|---|---|
| Benchmark numbers | `/benchmark` | No — reads `benchmark_results.json` |
| Full re-run (baseline + agent) | `make evaluate` | Yes (Gemini API key) |
| Verify file consistency | `make verify-benchmark` | No |
| Alex fraud report | `/report/riveradevops` | No (demo audit evidence) |
| Company dashboard | `/company/login` demo | No |
| Voice interview | `/apply/devops_job` → link | Polly optional; mic + Chrome required |
| `make evaluate` | [REPRODUCTION.md](./REPRODUCTION.md) | Yes (local clone) |

## Why this stands out among ~2000 submissions

- **Deployable SaaS**, not a CLI script
- **Fair baseline** on same 10 cases with ground truth labels
- **Measured improvement** with exported trajectories
- **Unique stack:** micro1 agent pattern + hiring pipeline (voice, AR, dashboard)
- **Evidence-based hot take:** path-guessing → tool design fix
